An '''unidentified individual''' served as the [[Shadow Hand]] of the last [[Sith King|King]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]]<ref name="END" /> [[Hakagram Graush]] circa [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> As a Shadow Hand, they acted as the king's second-in-command.<ref name="END" /> When a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exiles]] set foot on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the sacred [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Sith, the Shadow Hand betrayed their master. He or she helped the powerful strangers lure the Sith monarch into their confidence and [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.<ref name="END" /> It took [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] for the offworlders to understand the power structure of the Sith society and successfully undermine it from within. It was [[Ajunta Pall]], the leader of the Exiles, who eventually [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] King Graush with the monarch's own [[Sith war sword|war sword]]. After Hakagram Graush's death, Pall took the mantle of King and appointed his fellow Dark Jedi as his new Shadow Hands.<ref name="BOS" />

==Behind the scenes==
King Graush's right-hand person was first mentioned in ''[[Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties]]'', an article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] as an exclusive [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] publication.<ref name="END" /> In the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]], Graush's Shadow Hand went unmentioned. However, the book does mention that the Jedi Exiles dismantled the Sith society from within.<ref name="BOS" />
